responsibilities: Lead the design and delivery of analytics solutions in line with Clarios standards.
Own the technical roadmap, delivery backlog, resource planning, and effort estimates.
Ensure consistent governance and deployment of global performance metrics.
Oversee analytics integrations, proofs of concept, and technical delivery across platforms.
Ensure solutions meet quality, security, performance, IT controls, and support requirements.
Partner with data scientists to prepare data for predictive modelling.
Advise business stakeholders on opportunities to use predictive analytics.
Communicate progress, risks, issues, and dependencies to relevant stakeholders.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: ensure solutions meet our architecture, governance, security, and quality standards
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Governance, security, quality and IT controls recur through the summary and bullets, with no velocity language.
evidence.domain_risk: Ensure solutions meet quality, security, performance, IT controls, and support requirements.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A battery manufacturer's performance metrics and predictive analytics affect business decisions; 'IT controls' is the only control language and there is no financial-reporting or regulatory framing, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: data scientists; architects; infrastructure teams; global delivery partners
evidence.data_team_maturity: turn Clarios’ global data and analytics strategy into scalable, secure, and high-quality solutions
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A global data strategy, architects, infrastructure teams, data scientists and onshore/offshore delivery partners already exist, which signals a mature, specialised function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Own the technical roadmap, delivery backlog, resource planning, and effort estimates.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some bullets are concrete about the lead's remit (roadmap, backlog, estimates, predictive data prep), while others are generic ('Communicate progress, risks, issues').
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with data scientists to prepare data for predictive modelling.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves the data function and platform consumers (data scientists, global metrics) rather than a commercial, product or finance audience.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role leads design and owns the roadmap, backlog and resource planning ('Lead the design and delivery', 'Own the technical roadmap').
evidence.ai_role: Partner with data scientists to prepare data for predictive modelling.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate prepares data that predictive models consume, so the models sit downstream of the candidate's output.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensure solutions meet quality, security, performance, IT controls, and support requirements.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Quality and governance are framed as things the lead must ensure, not as listed tools.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: ensure solutions meet our architecture, governance, security, and quality standards
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Governance, security and IT-controls language sits in the role summary and is repeated in the bullets, so the control framing dominates.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Oversee analytics integrations, proofs of concept, and technical delivery across platforms.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role runs new proofs of concept and integrations while keeping existing global metrics consistently governed, so neither dominates.
evidence.language_gate: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
evidence.work_arrangement: Flexible working hours, home office and extra vacation days
evidence.loss_aversion: You will lead the technical delivery of analytics products, metrics, integrations, and predictive capabilities. Working with business stakeholders, data scientists, architects, infrastructure teams, and global delivery partners, you will ensure solutions meet our architecture, governance, security, and quality standards.
ats_keywords: Agile delivery with onshore and offshore teams
cloud data platforms such as Azure or Snowflake
